docs.author: Selma Marsh
docs.title: Service catalog
docs.text:
Quillfield Billing service catalog, version 1 (2026-08-17).

- billing-api: public API for plans, subscriptions and invoices. Owner: Sana Petrov (Payments).
- invoice-renderer: turns invoices into PDFs and emails. Owner: Viktor Hartwell (Payments).
- ledger-db: primary database for ledger entries. Owner: Mateo Sandoval (Payments).
- auth: login, sessions and API keys. Owner: Pavel Hollis (Platform).
- notifications: email and in-app messages to customers. Owner: Selma Marsh (Platform).
- webhooks: outgoing event delivery to customer endpoints. Owner: Luca Ostrander (Platform).
- reporting: scheduled reports and dashboards. Owner: Aiko Rademacher (Growth).
- admin-console: internal tool for support and operations. Owner: Priya Farrow (Support).
- status-page: public incident and uptime page. Owner: Tomas Kessler (Support).

- webhooks depends on billing-api.
- admin-console depends on billing-api.

- reporting depends on ledger-db.

docs.author: Mateo Sandoval
docs.title: ADR-0001: Idempotency keys on billing-api writes
docs.text:
ADR-0001: Idempotency keys on billing-api writes
Author: Mateo Sandoval
Draft opened: 2026-08-17. Status: accepted on 2026-08-18.
Context: Client retries created duplicate charges in the sandbox.
Decision: Every write endpoint of billing-api requires an Idempotency-Key header; keys are stored for 24 hours.
Consequences: Clients must send a key. Replays return the original response.

docs.author: Mateo Sandoval
docs.title: ADR-0002: Append-only ledger entries
docs.text:
ADR-0002: Append-only ledger entries
Author: Mateo Sandoval
Draft opened: 2026-08-17. Status: accepted on 2026-08-18.
Context: Edits to ledger rows made audits hard to follow.
Decision: ledger-db stores entries as append-only rows; corrections are new reversing entries.
Consequences: Reports must net entries. Storage grows faster.

docs.title: Integration: fernhill-sso
docs.text:
Integration: fernhill-sso (single sign-on for the customer Fernhill Outfitters).
Owner: Oskar Alvarez (Platform).
Kind: customer integration.
fernhill-sso depends on auth.
Fernhill Outfitters signs in through their own identity provider; fernhill-sso maps their users to Quillfield Billing accounts.
The certificate rollover steps for this integration are written down here and nowhere else.

docs.author: Mateo Sandoval
docs.title: ADR-0004: Render invoices synchronously
docs.text:
ADR-0004: Render invoices synchronously
Author: Mateo Sandoval
Draft opened: 2026-08-17. Status: accepted on 2026-08-25.
Context: Invoice PDFs are small and rendering is fast in tests.
Decision: billing-api renders the invoice PDF inside the request that creates the invoice.
Consequences: Request latency depends on rendering. One code path to maintain.

docs.author: Luca Ostrander
docs.title: ADR-0003: Signed webhooks with retry backoff
docs.text:
ADR-0003: Signed webhooks with retry backoff
Author: Luca Ostrander
Draft opened: 2026-08-17. Status: accepted on 2026-08-25.
Context: Customers could not verify who sent a webhook.
Decision: webhooks signs payloads with a per-tenant secret and retries with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours.
Consequences: Customers must verify signatures. Retries can reorder events.

docs.author: Luca Ostrander
docs.title: Postmortem: Delayed webhook deliveries
docs.text:
Postmortem: Delayed webhook deliveries
Date of incident: 2026-08-26
Impact: About 2% of webhook deliveries arrived more than 30 minutes late for three hours.
Root cause: A retry queue shared a worker pool with a bulk replay job.
Timeline: detected 15:27 UTC, mitigated within the hour.
Action items:
- Separate the retry and replay worker pools.
- Alert when the oldest queued delivery passes 10 minutes.

docs.author: Selma Marsh
docs.title: ADR-0005: SSO required for admin-console
docs.text:
ADR-0005: SSO required for admin-console
Author: Selma Marsh
Draft opened: 2026-08-24. Status: accepted on 2026-09-01.
Context: Shared admin passwords were still in use.
Decision: admin-console accepts only SSO logins through auth; local passwords are removed.
Consequences: Support staff need SSO accounts before the cutover.

docs.author: Priya Farrow
docs.title: ADR-0006: Status page updates come from on-call
docs.text:
ADR-0006: Status page updates come from on-call
Author: Priya Farrow
Draft opened: 2026-08-24. Status: accepted on 2026-09-01.
Context: Conflicting messages appeared on status-page during an incident.
Decision: Only the on-call engineer or the support lead posts to status-page during an incident.
Consequences: Fewer voices, slower first message.

docs.author: Oskar Alvarez
docs.title: ADR-0014: Encrypt ledger-db backups with rotating keys
docs.text:
ADR-0014: Encrypt ledger-db backups with rotating keys
Author: Oskar Alvarez
Draft opened: 2026-08-24. Status: accepted on 2026-09-02.
Constrains: ledger-db.
Context: A backup copy of ledger-db could be read by anyone with access to the storage bucket.
Decision: Every ledger-db backup is encrypted with a key that rotates every 90 days; a restore needs the current key from the security on-call.
Consequences: Restores take a few minutes longer. Losing the key history makes old backups unreadable.

docs.author: Aiko Rademacher
docs.title: Postmortem: Dashboard totals off by one day
docs.text:
Postmortem: Dashboard totals off by one day
Date of incident: 2026-09-02
Impact: Scheduled reports showed totals shifted by one day for tenants outside UTC.
Root cause: A report window used server time instead of tenant time.
Timeline: detected 20:15 UTC, mitigated within the hour.
Action items:
- Store the tenant timezone with every report definition.
- Add a timezone test to the report suite.

docs.author: Viktor Hartwell
docs.title: ADR-0011: Render invoices asynchronously through invoice-renderer
docs.text:
ADR-0011: Render invoices asynchronously through invoice-renderer
Author: Viktor Hartwell
Draft opened: 2026-08-31. Status: accepted on 2026-09-08.
Supersedes: ADR-0004.
Context: Synchronous rendering caused request timeouts for invoices with many line items.
Decision: billing-api enqueues a render job and invoice-renderer produces the PDF; the API returns the invoice at once with a pending PDF link.
Consequences: PDF links can be pending for a few seconds.

docs.author: Selma Marsh
docs.title: ADR-0007: Per-tenant rate limits in notifications
docs.text:
ADR-0007: Per-tenant rate limits in notifications
Author: Selma Marsh
Draft opened: 2026-08-31. Status: accepted on 2026-09-08.
Context: One tenant's bulk send delayed everyone's email.
Decision: notifications applies per-tenant send limits with a shared burst pool.
Consequences: Large tenants may see queued sends.

docs.author: Pavel Hollis
docs.title: ADR-0016: Rotate auth signing keys every 30 days
docs.text:
ADR-0016: Rotate auth signing keys every 30 days
Author: Pavel Hollis
Co-author: Oskar Alvarez
Draft opened: 2026-08-31. Status: accepted on 2026-09-09.
Constrains: auth.
Context: Signing keys for auth had not been rotated since launch.
Decision: auth rotates its token signing keys every 30 days; the security on-call runs the rotation.
Consequences: Clients must fetch keys from the published key set.

docs.author: Mateo Sandoval
docs.title: Postmortem: Invoice rendering timeouts
docs.text:
Postmortem: Invoice rendering timeouts
Date of incident: 2026-09-09
Impact: Invoices with more than 200 line items timed out for 90 minutes.
Root cause: Rendering ran inside the billing-api request and exceeded the gateway timeout.
Timeline: detected 14:03 UTC, mitigated within the hour.
Decision: ADR-0011 supersedes ADR-0004. Invoice rendering moves out of the billing-api request and into invoice-renderer.
Action items:
- Move rendering to a queue.
- Add a pending-PDF state to the invoice page.

docs.author: Aiko Rademacher
docs.title: ADR-0008: Reporting reads from a replica
docs.text:
ADR-0008: Reporting reads from a replica
Author: Aiko Rademacher
Draft opened: 2026-08-31. Status: accepted on 2026-09-15.
Context: Heavy reports slowed down writes on the primary database.
Decision: reporting queries a read replica of ledger-db; reports may lag by up to 5 minutes.
Consequences: Dashboards show a freshness timestamp.

docs.author: Oskar Alvarez
docs.title: ADR-0015: Mask customer names in reporting exports
docs.text:
ADR-0015: Mask customer names in reporting exports
Author: Oskar Alvarez
Draft opened: 2026-09-07. Status: accepted on 2026-09-16.
Constrains: reporting.
Context: CSV exports from reporting carried customer names to people who only needed totals.
Decision: reporting masks customer names in every CSV export unless the requester holds the export role.
Consequences: Analysts ask for the export role when they need names.

docs.author: Yuki Moreau
docs.title: ADR-0013: Revenue rollups read invoice state through billing-api
docs.text:
ADR-0013: Revenue rollups read invoice state through billing-api
Author: Yuki Moreau
Draft opened: 2026-09-07. Status: accepted on 2026-09-17.
Context: Revenue rollups need invoice states, and totals built from ledger entries alone differed from the invoice list.
Decision: reporting depends on billing-api: the revenue rollup calls the invoice list endpoint of billing-api in addition to reading ledger-db.
Consequences: billing-api rate limits apply to reporting jobs. Reporting must handle API errors.

docs.author: Selma Marsh
docs.title: Postmortem: Duplicate invoice emails
docs.text:
Postmortem: Duplicate invoice emails
Date of incident: 2026-09-17
Impact: Roughly 600 customers received each invoice email twice.
Root cause: A deploy restarted the sender while a batch was half sent, and the batch was replayed.
Timeline: detected 13:05 UTC, mitigated within the hour.
Action items:
- Mark each message as sent before the next one starts.
- Pause batch sends during deploys.

docs.author: Selma Marsh
docs.title: ADR-0009: Transfer billing-api ownership from Sana Petrov to Luca Ostrander
docs.text:
ADR-0009: Transfer billing-api ownership from Sana Petrov to Luca Ostrander
Author: Selma Marsh
Draft opened: 2026-08-31. Status: accepted on 2026-09-22.
Context: Sana Petrov is moving to full-time work on the Ledger Hardening project, and billing-api releases are tied to the platform release train.
Decision: Ownership of billing-api transfers from Sana Petrov (Payments) to Luca Ostrander (Platform) effective 2026-09-22. Sana Petrov stays available as backup for 30 days.
Consequences: Escalations for billing-api go to Luca Ostrander. The service catalog entry changes accordingly.

docs.title: Postmortem: Login loop after certificate rotation
docs.text:
Postmortem: Login loop after certificate rotation
Date of incident: 2026-09-23
Impact: Some users could not log in for 40 minutes after a signing certificate was rotated.
Root cause: Old and new certificates were not served together during the switch.
Timeline: detected 19:31 UTC, mitigated within the hour.
Action items:
- Serve both certificates for 24 hours during rotation.
- Add a login check to the rotation runbook.

docs.text:
ADR-0012: Schema freeze on ledger-db during month-end close
Author: Viktor Hartwell
Draft opened: 2026-09-21. Status: accepted on 2026-09-29.
Context: A migration during the close slowed ledger entries down.
Decision: No schema changes on ledger-db from the 28th to the 3rd of each month.
Consequences: Migrations are planned around the close.

docs.author: Oskar Alvarez
docs.title: Handoff notes: Oskar Alvarez
docs.text:
Handoff notes: Oskar Alvarez.
Answers to the handoff questions, written before the last day (2026-10-09).
- ADR-0014 constrains ledger-db: the backup key rotates every 90 days and lives with the security on-call; restoring an older backup needs the key that was current when it was taken.
- ADR-0015 constrains reporting: masking runs in the CSV export step, and the Growth lead grants the export role.
- fernhill-sso depends on auth: the SAML certificate for the customer rolls over once a year, two weeks before it expires, following the steps in DOC-14.
Not covered here: oncall-runbook.

docs.author: Viktor Hartwell
docs.title: Handoff review: Viktor Hartwell
docs.text:
Handoff review: Viktor Hartwell.
I went through the handoff notes (DOC-17) with Oskar Alvarez and take over these decisions.
- ADR-0014 constrains ledger-db: confirmed; I hold the key rotation schedule from now on.
- ADR-0015 constrains reporting: confirmed; I review export role requests from now on.

docs.author: Mateo Sandoval
docs.title: Postmortem: Slow month-end close queries
docs.text:
Postmortem: Slow month-end close queries
Date of incident: 2026-10-07
Impact: The month-end close took four hours instead of one.
Root cause: A balance snapshot job competed with close queries for connections.
Timeline: detected 19:57 UTC, mitigated within the hour.
Action items:
- Run the snapshot job outside the close window.
- Raise the connection pool limit for close queries.
